name: Quintanilla Vivar (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Quintanilla Vivar (a sword and a tower on green above waves, crosses and roundels).
history: Municipal flag of Quintanilla Vivar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Quintanilla Vivar arms — sword and tower above waves, crosses and roundels
